objective: Verify the visible WordPress admin surface is operational and no longer exposes architecture-builder process language.
preconditions: Plugin is available in the local WordPress runtime.
steps: Render Dashboard, Filter Presets, CPT Manager, and Integrations pages through WP-CLI.
Assert the rendered HTML does not include visible frame-builder product terms.
Assert Filter Presets and CPT Manager expose forms or actions for real saved options.
Check state-changing actions for nonce and capability enforcement.
expected_result: Admin pages behave as product tools for presets and content models rather than as a visual frame plan.
pass_criteria: no visible Frame chip or architecture-builder copy
Filter Presets page has save and delete affordances
CPT Manager page has save and delete affordances
nonce fields exist on save forms
evidence_required: code references for capability and nonce checks
